videos.t: World's Strangest Tricycle Race - Georgia Tech Mini 500
videos.desc:
For more than 50 years, Georgia Tech has been racing tricycles as a homecoming tradition. Follow our team through the journey of building a trike and attempting to win the race during the hilariously ridiculous tradition that is "The Mini 500."

----------------------------

My name is Anthony Limiero, and I make engineering content on YouTube. I'm also an extreme unicyclist and a self-published fantasy author. If you're interested in any of those things, check out the links below:

Anthony Engineers: https://www.youtube.com/@AnthonyEngineers
The Unicrew: https://www.youtube.com/c/TheUnicrew
